ns2:course.label: Video Reporting & Storytelling
ns2:course.description: Introduces news studio and field production and principles of field reporting and editing of news video; principles of planning, producing, and directing news and public affairs programs. Credit is not given for JOUR 340 if credit for JOUR 440 has been earned. Prerequisite: JOUR 210.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for JOUR 340 if credit for JOUR 440 has been earned. Prerequisite: JOUR 210.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Journalism or Agricultural Communications major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
